list.pageSubtitle: Apply for and manage staff loans — equal-installment flat-rate or declining-balance repayment, gated by approval before any repayment schedule exists.
list.employeePickerDescription: Loans are always viewed per employee — there is no combined list across every employee.
list.listDescription: Every loan this employee has ever applied for, most recent first.
list.noEmployeePickedDescription: Choose an employee above to see their loan history and apply for a new loan.

createDialog.title: New staff loan application
createDialog.description: Submits a loan application for approval. No repayment schedule exists yet — the schedule is only generated once this application is approved.
createDialog.rateHint: Enter the ANNUAL rate as a decimal fraction — e.g. 0.145 for 14.5% per year. This is the full yearly rate, never a monthly rate, and never a percentage written as a whole number (0.145, not 14.5).
createDialog.flatHint: Flat rate: equal principal every installment. Interest is a flat amount every period — (principal × annual rate) ÷ 12 — computed once on the original principal and never recalculated against the declining balance, so total interest paid is higher than reducing balance at the same nominal rate.
createDialog.reducingHint: Reducing balance: standard declining-balance repayment. Interest shrinks every period as the balance is paid down; the final installment absorbs any small rounding remainder so the schedule reconciles exactly to zero.
createDialog.noPreviewHint: No repayment schedule can be previewed here — it is generated in full, for real, only once this application is approved.
createDialog.genericError: Couldn't submit this loan application. Please try again.

decideDialog.approveDescription: This activates the loan immediately, resets its balance to the full principal, and generates its entire repayment schedule in one step. There is no way to preview the schedule beforehand, and this cannot be undone by rejecting afterward.
decideDialog.rejectDescription: This ends the application — it will never become active and no repayment schedule is ever generated for it.
decideDialog.writtenOffNotice: Rejecting marks this loan Written Off, not "Rejected" — there is no separate Rejected status. A Written Off loan permanently stays that way; there is no way to reopen or re-approve it afterward.
decideDialog.genericError: Couldn't record this decision. Please try again.

scheduleTable.notYetGeneratedNotice: No repayment schedule exists yet — it will be generated automatically, in full, once this loan is approved. This is expected, not an error.
scheduleTable.writtenOffNoScheduleNotice: This loan was rejected before it ever became active, so no repayment schedule was ever generated for it. This is expected, not an error.

recordRecoveryDialog.title: Manually record a recovery
recordRecoveryDialog.description: An out-of-band correction tool — real payroll runs record recoveries automatically at commit time. Use this only to correct or backfill a recovery outside the normal payroll run.
recordRecoveryDialog.periodPlaceholder: Select a period from this loan's own schedule
recordRecoveryDialog.periodHint: Only periods that genuinely exist on this loan's own schedule can be picked — this must match one of them exactly.
recordRecoveryDialog.amountHint: Prefilled with this installment's remaining due amount — adjust if recording a different real amount.
recordRecoveryDialog.genericError: Couldn't record this recovery. Please try again.

settleEarlyDialog.title: Settle this loan early?
settleEarlyDialog.description: A lump-sum payoff, not a partial payment.
settleEarlyDialog.lumpSumNotice: This cancels every remaining installment on the schedule that hasn't yet had a recovery recorded against it, and closes the loan at a zero balance immediately — regardless of what the real outstanding balance was. This cannot be undone.
settleEarlyDialog.settlementDateHint: Installments due after this date's month are cancelled; installments already recovered against are left untouched.
settleEarlyDialog.genericError: Couldn't settle this loan early. Please try again.

detail.settledNoActionsHint: This loan is settled — no further actions are available.

list.pageSubtitle: Create, compute, review, and submit payroll runs for approval — the real end-to-end run engine, one period at a time.
list.listDescription: Filter by period or status, or leave both blank to see every run.

createDialog.title: New payroll run
createDialog.description: Creates a DRAFT run for a period. A run is genuinely system-wide — there is no department or employee-subset scope here; it will consider every active employee once computed.
createDialog.periodKeyHint: The calendar month this run covers.
createDialog.mainHint: The regular run for this period.
createDialog.supplementaryHint: A correction run for a period that already has a MAIN run — requires picking which MAIN run it corrects, below.
createDialog.supplementsRunIdPlaceholder: Select the MAIN run this corrects
createDialog.supplementsRunIdHint: Required for a SUPPLEMENTARY run — the server rejects creating one without this.
createDialog.genericError: Couldn't create this payroll run. Please try again.

actions.genericError: Couldn't complete this action. Please try again.
actions.returnNotRejectionNotice: This returns the run to Review — it is NOT a rejection. Pyrl_run status has no separate "rejected" state, and the run itself stays fully editable and recomputable. Note a real limitation: the original approval request stays open in the background, so submitting for approval again before it's resolved will fail with a clear conflict error rather than being silently ignored — if that happens, cancel the open request from Approvals first, then submit again.
actions.computeConfirmDescription: Resolves every active employee's structure lines, personal overrides, statutory deductions, and loan recovery for this period, and builds a real payslip line for each one covered by an assignment. This can be run again later if anything changes.
actions.recomputeConfirmDescription: This WIPES every existing payslip line on this run and rebuilds all of them from scratch — any one-off entered since the last compute will now be included. This cannot be undone once submitted.
actions.reviewConfirmDescription: Generates the variance report — comparing this run's figures against the most recent prior committed MAIN run for an earlier period, if one exists.
actions.submitConfirmDescription: Submits a real approval request for the run's total net pay. Once submitted, the run cannot be computed or reviewed again until a decision is recorded.
actions.approveConfirmDescription: Approves the run. Committing, paying, and filing it are separate actions covered in a later part of this module.
actions.returnConfirmDescription: Sends the run back to Review status so it can be adjusted and resubmitted — this is not a rejection, and the run is not closed out in any way.
actions.filedNotice: This run is Filed — the terminal state. No further lifecycle action is available; committing, paying, and filing are all complete.
actions.commitConfirmDescription: Posts one real, aggregated journal to the general ledger (payroll expense, statutory payables, staff loan recoveries, and net pay payable), and genuinely finalizes every line's own loan recovery for the first time. This is a real, final accounting action, not a draft.
actions.commitNotReversibleNotice: This is not casually reversible. Once committed, this run's journal is posted to the general ledger and every affected loan's balance is permanently reduced — there is no "undo commit" action anywhere in this module.
actions.fileConfirmDescription: Marks this period's statutory filing as administratively complete. This does NOT generate or submit any real P10, NSSF, SHIF, or AHL filing documents — that remains a separate, not-yet-built reporting concern.
actions.fileNoDocumentsNotice: No filing documents are generated or submitted by this action — it only marks this period's filing as administratively complete in this system.

totalsCard.title: Totals

totalsCard.notComputedYetNotice: This run hasn't been computed yet — totals will appear here once it has.

varianceReport.notYetAvailableNotice: No variance report exists yet for this run.
varianceReport.noPriorRunNotice: No prior committed MAIN run is available for comparison — every employee in this run is treated as new rather than compared.

varianceReport.noNewNotice: No new employees compared to the prior run.

detail.notComputedYetNotice: This run hasn't been computed yet — no payslip lines exist. Use Compute above to build them.

payDialog.title: Pay this run
payDialog.description: Disburses this run's total net pay in a separate real journal, and marks every payslip line as paid.
payDialog.methodOnlyHint: Only a method is selected here — there is no way to choose a specific bank account for this disbursement. Each method resolves to one shared control account (Bank, Cash, or the M-Pesa clearing account), not a real, individually-selected bank account row.
payDialog.genericError: Couldn't complete this action. Please try again.

list.listDescription: Filter by status, or start a new run for a period that doesn't have one yet.

createDialog.title: Create a depreciation run
createDialog.description: Creates the run and computes every eligible active asset's charge for this period in the same step — there is no separate compute action.
createDialog.periodHint: At most one depreciation run can ever be created per period — a period that already has one is rejected with a clear error.
createDialog.genericError: Couldn't create this depreciation run. This period may already have one.

actions.postedNotice: This run is Posted — the terminal state. Its charges have been posted to the general ledger and it can never be changed again.
actions.approvedRecordedNotice: Decision recorded. This run's own status stays Pending Approval — there is no separate Approved state in this module; posting will independently verify the real approval before it proceeds.
actions.genericError: Couldn't complete this action. Please try again.
actions.submitConfirmDescription: Submits a real DEPRECIATION approval request for this run's total charge.
actions.approveConfirmDescription: Records an APPROVE decision on this run's approval request.
actions.noApprovedStateNotice: This module's run status has only three values — Draft, Pending Approval, and Posted. There is no separate "Approved" state: approving records the decision, but this run's own status stays Pending Approval until it is posted, which independently re-checks the real approval before proceeding.
actions.returnConfirmDescription: Records a RETURN decision and reverts this run to Draft so it can be resubmitted later — this is not a rejection, and the run's own computed lines are untouched.
actions.postConfirmDescription: Posts one journal per category to the general ledger — debiting each category's depreciation expense account and crediting its accumulated depreciation account — and increases every affected asset's own accumulated depreciation by its line amount.
actions.postNotReversibleNotice: This is not reversible. Once posted, this run becomes permanently locked — no further change of any kind is possible, not even a status update. Corrections require a brand-new run in a later period.

linesTable.title: Computed lines
linesTable.description: Every eligible active asset's charge for this run's period, computed in the same call that created the run.
linesTable.categoryTotalsHint: Posting aggregates one journal per category — a debit to its depreciation expense account and a credit to its accumulated depreciation account, for exactly these totals.

list.pageSubtitle: The disposal wizard — dispose of an asset by sale, scrap, donation, or write-off, computing and freezing its gain or loss against net book value at creation.
list.listDescription: Filter by status, or start a new disposal for an asset that hasn't been disposed of yet.

createDialog.title: Dispose of an asset
createDialog.description: Pick an asset and a method, and optionally enter proceeds — the gain or loss against net book value is computed and frozen the moment you create this disposal.
createDialog.assetAlreadyDisposedWarning: This asset has already been disposed of or written off — an asset can only ever be disposed once.
createDialog.proceedsHint: Optional — the cash or value received for this asset. Leave blank to default to 0.
createDialog.proceedsZeroHint: Optional — Donation and Write-off disposals typically have no proceeds, so this defaults to 0. Enter a real figure only if some value was actually received.
createDialog.previewHint: Computed the same way the server will: proceeds minus net book value (cost minus accumulated depreciation). This exact figure is frozen once the disposal is created.
createDialog.genericError: Couldn't create this disposal. This asset may already have been disposed of.

actions.postedNotice: This disposal is Posted — the terminal state. Its journal has been posted to the general ledger and the asset's status is now Disposed.
actions.genericError: Couldn't complete this action. Please try again.
actions.submitConfirmDescription: Submits a real ASSET_DISPOSALS approval request. The amount shown to the approver is this disposal's proceeds when positive, or the absolute value of its gain/loss when proceeds is zero — so a zero-cash donation or write-off still shows a meaningful figure, never a misleading zero.
actions.approveConfirmDescription: Records an APPROVE decision on this disposal's approval request. This disposal's own status becomes Approved immediately and stays that way until it's posted.
actions.returnConfirmDescription: Records a RETURN decision and reverts this disposal to Draft, clearing its approval reference, so it can be corrected and resubmitted — this is not a rejection.
actions.postConfirmDescription: Posts the real disposal journal — debiting proceeds and accumulated depreciation where applicable, debiting a loss or crediting a gain depending on the sign of the gain/loss, and always crediting the full asset cost — and sets the asset's status to Disposed, regardless of this disposal's own method.
actions.postNotReversibleNotice: This is not reversible. Once posted, this disposal is permanently locked, a real journal is posted to the general ledger, and the asset's status becomes Disposed — regardless of this disposal's own method.

journalPreview.postedDescription: The real journal lines this disposal posted to the general ledger.
journalPreview.previewDescription: What will post once this disposal is posted, computed client-side from the same real formula — not yet a real journal.
journalPreview.livePreviewNote: This is a live preview, not a posted journal. The accumulated-depreciation line reflects this asset's CURRENT accumulated depreciation — if a depreciation run posts for this asset before this disposal is posted, the real posted amount may differ from this preview.

detail.methodVsStatusNote: This disposal's method describes why the asset left service — the asset's own status only ever becomes "Disposed," regardless of method, even for a Write-off.

actions.postNotReversibleNotice: This is not reversible. Once posted, this session is permanently locked — condition updates have been applied and the missing-asset report is final.
